1.description: [Pending Restart] Hypnosis now lasts for 6 sec, changed from 8.

2.description: Raider’s Commendations are no longer restricted to the previous tier of content. You can now trade Raider’s Commendations on gear up to the current tier you have completed, with the exception of the last boss of each raid.  This opens your ability to obtain current gear to progress the current raid to the final boss while keeping final boss loot a worthy prize for progressing content.  Since the last raid boss items still unlock in the next tier, the best most iconic items are still highly prized, and it will always be worth pushing the latest raid forward.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Doomwalker & Doom Lord Kazzak (TBC) now provide 12 Raiders Commendation up from 6.

[Pending Restart] - With updated world boss loot, on Area-52 (and once Hyjal releases for Thrall), world bosses will be able to drop Mythic Versions of their items (upscaled versions of their loot). With the release of SSC, Heroic Versions of the items are now available from World Bosses.
[Pending Restart] - The optional bosses in Karazhan: Maiden of Virtue, Terrestian Illhoof, Netherspite, Nightbane now drop 3 Raider's Commendation up from 2.
[Pending Restart] - Gruul the Dragonslayer and Magtheridon now drop 9 raider's commendations, up from 6.
[Pending Restart] - Items like The Night Blade, Blinkstrike, Cloak of Dark Bargains are purchasable from the Mythic0 coin vendor, however are soulbound upon purchasing.

[Pending Restart] - World Bosses in TBC now drop personal loot caches akin to the ones that are found from World Bosses in Azeroth. This personal loot cache functions like a callboard cache, but has a chance at containing the loot from the World Boss. (As a reminder, all loot from world bosses is Bound when Equipped, so you can trade this as much as you want).

Fixed an issue causing Serpent’s Kiss (from the Improved Serpent Sting Capstone) to deal less damage than intended and be unable to critically strike.
The Moonfury Capstone now also makes your next Moonfire a guaranteed critical.
Amplify Curse Capstone now triggers when your Curse of Agony or Curse of the Elements is dispelled. The follow-up damage can be triggered by any Warlock Curse.

Burning Determination, Frozen Core, Celestial Focus and Spiritual Focus now also has this effect: Being hit by an interrupt effect while not casting makes you immune to the next Crowd Control, Knockback, Silence or Interrupt effect against you and gives you 20% spell haste for 5 seconds. This may only occur once every 20 seconds.
Avatar now gives 25% damage reduction initially. The damage reduction is then reduced by 10% every 4 seconds.
